parent_objective: implement actor_mean-only temporal repair update with M1011 margin-weighted branch trust residual
blocked_by: M1012 design must be implemented before any M267/M264 replay preflight
invalidates: direct replay or PPO from M1002 temporal candidates

public_gates: M1013 must preserve P0 actor inputs
M1013 must gate candidates with exact temporal and M1011 branch-trust metrics before replay
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train recurrent or encoder parameters
do not run full replay before exact/trust candidate selection
do not change actor input contract
do not relax branch trust thresholds inside the same milestone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the M1012 actor_mean-only repair objective can produce exact temporal progress without active wrong-branch drift
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective-level candidate search only; no replay promotion, no PPO, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if no candidate passes exact temporal gates
stop if all exact candidates violate M1011 branch trust gates
stop if any non-actor_mean parameter changes
fallback_plan: if temporal progress is blocked, audit coefficient scale or synthesize
if branch retention is blocked, consider trajectory-target export or wider trust projection only after audit
if exact/trust candidates exist, route to M267/M264 replay preflight design

hypothesis: The M1012 actor_mean-only repair objective can produce at least one exact temporal candidate that stays inside the M1011 margin-weighted wrong-branch trust region.
success_criteria: at least one candidate passes exact temporal gates
at least one exact candidate passes M1011 branch trust gates
failure_criteria: all candidates fail exact temporal gates
all exact candidates fail M1011 branch trust gates
